name: canon
description: Canon: enforce the canonical way. A code plugin that locks Claude onto the latest official framework APIs, and a Chinese plugin that forces plain, jargon-free writing.

plugins.name: canon
plugins.description: Strict latest-official-API conventions for Vue 3.5 / Nuxt UI v4 / Tailwind v4 / TypeScript / Go Echo v5 + sqlc / Node Fastify v5 / PostgreSQL / Astro. Framework skills auto-activate by file path; deprecated patterns are forbidden, current best practices are forced. Plus two manual workflow commands: /canon:go (work discipline) and /canon:cm (structured, spec-compliant commits).

plugins.name: canon-chinese
plugins.description: Forces plain, jargon-free Simplified Chinese and strips AI-tic phrasing. Ships as an output style that applies automatically once enabled.
